findings.issue: paperState and isolated read visibility from computed display on rows and theads; a row inside a display:none table still computes table-row, so a hidden per-phase table (or a whole segment) leaves every paper expectation green while phases vanish from the PDF. Proven with two injected print rules.
findings.resolution: Read visibility from painted boxes (getClientRects or checkVisibility) and prove both injections red.

findings.issue: The stress print runs on every invocation, two of them concurrently in verify.sh's report slice, each about 44 s and about 7 GB renderer RSS, on a 16 GB CI runner with a 15-minute job bound: the exit-143 shape the bug recorded.
findings.resolution: Run the stress once per slice, opted in, on a leg that runs alone.

findings.issue: Only page.pdf is raced against the bound; goto has timeout 0 and the growth, measurement and emulateMedia calls are unbounded, so a hang in setup is caught only by the job timeout with no message naming the block.
findings.resolution: Bound the whole stress block under one race and name it in the timeout message.

intent.note: Design (b) as described: exports.js cutForPaper/joinAfterPaper on beforeprint/afterprint move rows into one table per phase with a cloned thead; print CSS hides the original, fixes widths and moves the segment break. Round trip driven in a real browser across search, sort, expand, view, date preset, status chip, combinations, page.pdf twice and per-segment print: exact. Stress print red on HEAD's render, green on this one. The three findings were raised on the uncommitted diff and fixed by the executor before the commit; this return records the review as given.
intent.redFirstBasis: regression mode, expectRedFirst false; the stress red on HEAD was reproduced by the reviewer.
intent.inheritedTestsBasis: the paper assertions in check-report-interactive.mjs would have passed with whole parts hidden (finding 1).
